name: Celestial Familiar
body:
You open a conduit to the upper planes to invest your familiar with its essence.

Prerequisite(s): Familiar, 5th level, non-evil alignment

Benefit(s): Your familiar gains the celestial simple template, though its type remains unchanged. If you gain an improved familiar, that familiar also gains this template unless it possesses the evil subtype.

Special: A familiar cannot gain both the celestial and fiendish simple templates.
